pages.title: About Us
pages.page_body:
Kartly is a homegrown online store for fashion, gadgets and lifestyle products — handpicked quality, honest prices, free shipping above ₹999 and easy 7-day returns.

Our story

Kartly started with a simple idea: everyday style, delivered to your door. Today a passionate team carries that promise forward every day.

What we believe

  • People first
  • Quality without shortcuts
  • Honest, transparent communication

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.page_body:
Kartly respects your privacy. We collect only the information you share with us through our forms, use it only to respond to you, and never sell it.

Contact us anytime to view or delete your data.

pages.title: Terms of Use
pages.page_body: By using the Kartly website you agree to use it lawfully. Content is for general information and may change without notice.

faqs.title: How long does delivery take?
faqs.answer: Metro cities: 2-4 days. Rest of India: 4-7 working days.

faqs.title: Is Cash on Delivery available?
faqs.answer: Yes, COD is available on most pin codes.

faqs.title: What is the return policy?
faqs.answer: Easy 7-day returns on unused items with tags. Refunds within 5-7 days.

faqs.title: Are payments secure?
faqs.answer: All online payments are processed by Razorpay — we never see your card details.
